title: Trulioo
subtitle: Software Engineer Intern · Vancouver, BC
summary: Improving service performance, observability, and modernization across .NET systems.

sections.title: Encryption performance
sections.body: Reduced peak memory use by **80.4%** and encryption/decryption time by **50%** in an internal encryption library by precomputing message size and replacing intermediate streams with one preallocated buffer.

sections.title: Workflow observability
sections.body: Instrumented **5 workflows and 52 stages** with step-level execution timing, using AsyncLocal and an accessor abstraction to propagate context through asynchronous processing.

sections.title: Production logging
sections.body: Reduced disk usage by **80%** across **9 services** by standardizing NLog retention and correcting archive rotation across date boundaries.

sections.title: Service modernization
sections.body: Automated .NET 8-to-10 modernization across **7 services**, updated **20+ dependencies**, and remediated **30+ vulnerabilities** with a reusable coding-agent SKILL that generated review-ready merge requests.
